## Model Lab: how the detectors were trained and tested
**Data:** CSE-CIC-DDoS2019, 69.9 million flows over two capture days, 55 features after removing identifiers and testbed fingerprints.   |   **Standard test:** train on 80% of the distinct traffic patterns, test on the other 20%.   |   **Cross-day test:** train on day 1, test on day 2.   |   **Sample:** all benign rows plus 20 attack rows per benign row. **All rows:** every training row.   |   **Macro-F1** averages the benign and attack F1 scores, so the rare benign class counts as much as the attack class.

targets.rawSql: select model || '  ' || round(macro_f1::numeric, 3) as best from model_summary where task = 'detection' and experiment = 'standard' order by macro_f1 desc limit 1
select model || '  ' || round(macro_f1::numeric, 3) as best from model_summary where task = 'detection' and experiment = 'cross_day' order by macro_f1 desc limit 1

panels.title: Random Forest cross-day: sample → all rows

targets.rawSql: select round(max(case when training = 'sample' then macro_f1 end)::numeric, 2) || ' → ' || round(max(case when training = 'all_rows' then macro_f1 end)::numeric, 2) as change from model_summary where task = 'detection' and experiment = 'cross_day' and model = 'random_forest'
select macro_f1 from model_summary where task = 'family' and training = 'all_rows'

panels.title: Standard test: macro-F1, sample vs all rows

targets.rawSql: select model, round(max(case when training = 'sample' then macro_f1 end)::numeric, 3) as sample, round(max(case when training = 'all_rows' then macro_f1 end)::numeric, 3) as all_rows from model_summary where task = 'detection' and experiment = 'standard' group by model order by model

panels.title: Cross-day test (train day 1, test day 2): macro-F1, sample vs all rows

targets.rawSql: select model, round(max(case when training = 'sample' then macro_f1 end)::numeric, 3) as sample, round(max(case when training = 'all_rows' then macro_f1 end)::numeric, 3) as all_rows from model_summary where task = 'detection' and experiment = 'cross_day' group by model order by model

select experiment, training, model, round(macro_f1::numeric, 4) as macro_f1, round(benign_auc_pr::numeric, 4) as benign_auc_pr from model_summary where task = 'detection' order by experiment, training, macro_f1 desc
select feature, importance from feature_importance order by importance desc limit 15

panels.title: Tuning trials: every setting tried, scored on validation data (benign F1)

targets.rawSql: select experiment, model, settings, round(validation_benign_f1::numeric, 4) as validation_benign_f1, case when chosen then 'chosen' else '' end as chosen from tuning order by experiment, model, validation_benign_f1 desc

panels.title: Attack-type classifier (Random Forest, all rows): score per family

targets.rawSql: select label as family, round("precision"::numeric, 3) as precision_score, round(recall::numeric, 3) as recall_score, round(f1::numeric, 3) as f1_score, support as test_rows from class_scores where task = 'family' and training = 'all_rows' order by support desc
